I rejected trading for St. Charles from p2 because they previously refused cash for it and I still need States to complete the pink set. A combined offer of cash for both States and Ventnor would be too expensive. I also confirmed that selling Electric to p4 is forbidden.

The real priority is completing the yellow monopoly first. p4 appears strategic and may refuse to sell Ventnor if they believe they can acquire Atlantic Avenue later.

I am now worried that p4 could use the $200 to build brown houses or hotels, which would raise rent to $90–$180. I am considering raising the offer to $250–$300, though that leaves only about $108 after buying Marvin Gardens, which is too little to block Tennessee if I land there first.

I decided to offer $200 cash for Ventnor Avenue. This leaves me with roughly $468 after buying it, which preserves a $180 reserve to block Tennessee if I land there first. Denying Tennessee is critical because p1's orange monopoly is statistically the most landed-on set and would be devastating if completed.

I am now considering trading with p2 for Boardwalk. I have no property that would complete their dark blue set, so they cannot demand a full monopoly in return. I could offer them Pacific Avenue plus cash, though they already hold St. Charles Place and Virginia Avenue.

I am now considering trading with p1. They have $874 and want unowned Tennessee and p2's Illinois, so they might trade cash or a property I do not need in exchange for blocking me. I also noticed p4 is currently on Pacific Avenue, which I own.

I have decided to end the turn. The $200 cash offer for Ventnor Avenue is too risky. p4 would likely reject it or demand more. They could also use the cash to build brown houses. I will preserve my liquidity and wait for a better opportunity.

I considered trading Pacific Avenue and Atlantic Avenue for Boardwalk from p2, but that would give me a dark blue monopoly with roughly $568 in cash. I could build two houses immediately and charge $175–$200 in rent, which is game-ending, so p2 would never accept that offer. I also dismissed offering Park Place to p4 because it is too valuable.

I rejected buying North Carolina Avenue from p4 as a dead asset. I would still need Pennsylvania Avenue from p2, who would not sell it, and the cash would burn my Tennessee reserve. I will end the turn.

Mortgaging is unnecessary because I have $668 and no building opportunity. I will keep my public message brief and avoid revealing that I am saving for Tennessee and Marvin.

I briefly considered a swap with p4: I would give Pacific Avenue and cash for Ventnor and States. That would leave p4 with two greens and p2 with Penn, turning the green set into a negotiation between p2 and p4. It would not help me complete my yellow or pink monopolies.
